decisions.reason: An area elastic sports floor sits at the core of the firm's wood sports flooring know-how, so it can read market feedback and keep refining the system.
A mobile arena floor extends the firm's existing sports floor knowledge, though the post-COVID arena event market and overlap with Product C add some risk.
This second mobile arena system builds on the same absorbed knowledge, but its overlap with Product B makes consolidation somewhat more likely.
Chevron hardwood parquet draws directly on the firm's wood processing skills, and demand for the pattern was strong in residential renovation.
A squash court finish is a niche item, but it fits the firm's sports surface expertise and costs little to keep in the range.
Oak skirting is a simple complementary wood product that supports sales of the sports floor systems and needs little extra knowledge.
